title: g8keep (Base) launchpad — factory-locked LP and fee contracts: $0 unprivileged-extractable; 32.05 ETH ($77.4k) LP permanently locked

category_notes.E-U: No permissionless path pays the caller. All value movers are gated: factory withdrawToken/sellTokens/withdrawETH/setApprovalToUniswapRouter are onlyOwner; penaltyReceiver.transferToken is allowlist-gated; vester.claim is recipient-only; the 77 factory-held LP tokens are permanently locked (lockedTokens[pair]=1, no unlock function) and cannot be burned/transferred by anyone.
category_notes.H-O: g8keepVester holds 30+ launch tokens across 35 vestings (deployer-only claims) + third-party LP of 0.0024 ETH ($5.79) in 2 pairs. Not USD-quantifiable (illiquid launch tokens); counted as 0 in USD.
category_notes.P: Factory holds 138 non-locked ERC-20 balances (1% g8keep trade-fee accruals + spam airdrops) and the penalty receiver holds snipe-penalty tokens; both owner-only (owner EOA 0x28253c1A76256bf1D9095587826AfCC5705aF98a, dormant since 2025-02-12). Not USD-quantifiable; counted as 0.
category_notes.S: 32.046733 ETH attributable to the factory's LP across 77 pairs — unredeemable by anyone (LP locked in factory; no unlock/burn path). The pools remain live AMM markets; the WETH can only leave by trading launch tokens at AMM price.

closed_reasons: Factory-held LP tokens are permanently locked (lockedTokens[pair]=1 for 77/77 pairs; no function clears the flag; withdrawToken reverts TokenLocked; sellTokens and setApprovalToUniswapRouter skip locked tokens)
All factory value exits are onlyOwner (Solady Ownable; owner is a dormant EOA)
penaltyReceiver.transferToken requires allowlisted transferer (only the owner is allowlisted)
All snipe-protection windows expired (last deployment 2025-01-13; max window 30 days) — snipe code paths inert
No excess balances in any of the 77 pairs (pair balances == reserves) -> skim() yields nothing
Only permissionless entry point deployToken costs liquidity + 2% fee and locks the created LP (net loss)
key_facts: Factory 0x3C0B43867Cd04fEdfD6a95497e5ea7e3aFF8cCaE on Base: nonce 79 = 1 (EIP-161) + 1 penaltyReceiver + 77 deployToken calls -> exactly 77 deployed pairs; all 77 are WETH pairs and the factory holds ~100% of each LP (balance = totalSupply - 1000)
Total WETH attributable to factory-held LP: 32.046733 ETH = $77,446.66 at ETH $2,416.68 (DefiLlama 2026-10-14); top pool HUH/WETH holds 17.2665 ETH; total across all pairs 32.049129 ETH

lockedTokens[pair]=1 verified for 77/77 pairs via eth_getStorageAt(keccak256(pair, slot 6)); storage layout confirmed by getter matches (slot0=vester, slot1=feeWallet, slot2=penaltyReceiver+packed fees)
No excess (skim-able) balances in any pair: actual pair balances == reserves for all 77 pairs (local + CI)
Factory owner = fee wallet = 0x28253c1A76256bf1D9095587826AfCC5705aF98a (EOA, nonce 57, last outgoing tx block 26,298,905 = 2025-02-12, balance 0.1542 ETH); factory native and WETH balances are 0
Factory holds 138 non-locked ERC-20 balances (fee accruals + spam); owner-only withdrawals (withdrawToken/sellTokens)

g8keepVester 0x254b4A4222285BAa10E6eFce66a6EcfdF5d807A9: nextVestingId=35, holds 30+ launch tokens; claim recipient-only; deploymentVest is permissionless but cannot drain vester balances (token=msg.sender)
All snipe protection expired (HUH end 2024-11-30, GATE/G8 end 2024-11-04); last deployment block 25,007,167 = 2025-01-13
GeckoTerminal lists exactly one pool for HUH (this g8keep pool), 24h volume 0 -> no external source of cheap tokens for arbitrage against the locked pool
Fork PoC: all 10 tests pass on CI; every unprivileged extraction attempt reverts; deployToken demo shows the caller loses 0.01 ETH + 2% fee (0.0002 ETH) and the LP is locked
caveats: BASE_RPC_URL is empty in the CI environment; dump/tests fall back to public Base RPC (mainnet.base.org) -> exact block numbers differ between local (52,614,511) and CI (52,628,356) runs; totals agree to the wei-equivalent.
USD conversion uses DefiLlama ETH spot 2026-10-14 ($2,416.68); launch tokens themselves have no reliable price (illiquid) and are reported unquantified.
The 138 factory fee-token balances were enumerated via GoldRush indexer data and cross-checked against the factory nonce; individual token values are not relied upon.
The locked pools are live AMM markets: the WETH is tradeable out at AMM price (ordinary market activity), but the LP claim itself is unredeemable — classified S.
Triage's $1,000 estimate came from sampling 3 small pairs; full enumeration (77 pairs) gives 32.05 ETH locked.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live from g8keep: all 77 factory-held LP positions (32.046733 ETH = $77,446.66) are permanently locked and every value mover is owner-only/allowlisted/recipient-only; the triage's $1,000 figure was a 3-pair sample of a $77k locked total.
